يتراددا (form VI)
# يَتَرَادَدَا (yatarādadā) /ja.ta.raː.da.daː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَرَادَدَ (tarādada)
# يُتَرَادَدَا (yutarādadā) /ju.ta.raː.da.daː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَرَادَدَ (tarādada)
